title: Perception-of-Male-Caller-Identity-in-Koalas-(Phascolarctos-cinereus)-Acoustic-Analysis-and-pone.0020329.s001
author: Charlton B, Ellis W, McKinnon A, Brumm J, Nilsson K, Fitch W
changes: Male koala (Phascolarctos cinereus) named Andy bellowing at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary: the deep snoring and belching mating call. Trimmed to 14.48–17.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of Movie S1 from Charlton et al., 'Perception of Male Caller Identity in Koalas', PLOS ONE (2011), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0020329.
